scope: Bounded read-only inspection of retained Model Zoo source provenance, capture code, selected keyframes, current consumers and one decoded silent-master sample; not a new app or inference run

data_provenance.classification: Real acquired-microscopy crops, not synthetically generated images
data_provenance.recorded_signal: ER/cell channel, as identified by the preparation records; no new independent marker validation
data_provenance.verification: Read source arrays with mmap_mode=r; compare only the three selected channel-1 crops against the existing training and benchmark TIFFs; compare TIFF file SHA-256 values; do not regenerate assets
data_provenance.critical_limit: These are reused training examples, not held-out validation fields. The generator also states that production training requires independently reviewed masks and held-out evaluation. Pixel identity is not evidence of biological marker validity or segmentation accuracy.

historical_benchmark.actual_test_path: The capture script loads three existing fields, clicks screen._btn_test at line 125, waits for screen.result(), and records that result. It does not call set_segment_fn or inject a replacement segmentation function.
historical_benchmark.current_default_backend: spacr.model_compare.segment_with_cellpose, selected by spacr.model_zoo.benchmark when segment_fn is None
historical_benchmark.comparison_limit: 10_compare_handoff shows populated comparison inputs, not a completed two-model comparison.

current_text_and_catalogue_limits.retirement_scope: Filtered from current catalogue suggestions, not deleted from disk; historical frames must not imply current recommendation or availability in the catalogue.

assembly.shared_image_content: Newer Make Masks host with the Model Zoo fold open, but no scanned models, loaded fields, benchmark rows or comparison result
assembly.decoded_sample_content: Blank newer Make Masks/Model Zoo overview with a focus overlay, not the meaningful historical benchmark frame
assembly.sample_method: Decode one existing-video frame in memory through ffmpeg image2pipe; no saved frame or video output
assembly.limit: Only one encoded frame was visually inspected. The all-eight identical image binding is established from scenes.json; no claim that every encoded frame was individually inspected.
assembly.finding: The incorrect overview-only assembly is present in the encoded master, not merely in an unused authoring recipe.

minimum_update: Correct metadata that implies classifier benchmarking and remove the nonexistent license-field claim.
State that the demonstrated real crops were reused from training and are not held-out validation.
Restore meaningful saved workflow keyframes instead of binding every scene to the blank host-fold image.
Treat the old catalogue listing as historical, or use a bounded fresh current-GUI capture if current catalogue availability must be shown.
Do not rerun training or inference merely because navigation moved. The original crop provenance is now verified.
